doors.description: Each dwelling unit's door: the walk from its outer side to the nearest storey exit (BYKHY 48/4).

exits.description:
Each storey holding rooms and how many storey exits it has (BYKHY 4/u): an escape stair's room, an open
stair's foot or head, a door to the outside on a storey at or below ±0.00.

rooms.description: Every room (space), a void and an outdoor one too.

sprinklers.description:
The building has an automatic sprinkler system, as the project's settings say (`.kcad` 226): the fire
regulation's sprinklered distances are the ones read (BYKHY 48/2, Ek-5/B; docs/adr/8057 §53).

units.description: The building program's groups that have rooms, with article 4's areas, in the program's order.

zoning.description:
The parcel's zoning (İmar durumu) and the building's areas against it, when the project writes one
(docs/adr/8057 §92).

BuildingFacts.description: The building as the regulation's rules count it.

dwellings.description: Those of them whose nature is a dwelling's (Daire, Mesken, Konut) or not given.

local.description:
The municipality's regulation the project reads over the national one (`sivas`: Sivas Belediyesi İmar
Yönetmeliği, RG 10.11.2022/32009); absent: none.

rooms.description: The rooms that carry people as the escape rules count them (BYKHY Ek-5/A, docs/adr/8035), by persistent id.

storeys.description: Every storey of the project, lowest first.

units.description: The building program's independent units (bağımsız bölüm).

inserts.description: How many times it is inserted.

layers.description: The layers its inserts stand on, by name, each once, in order.

name.description: Its name, as the drawing's block library names it.

CadDerived.description: A section or an elevation drawn from its mark (docs/adr/8042, 8043).

inserts.description: How many times it is placed.

mark.description: Its mark's persistent id; none when the mark is gone.

state.description:
`current`: what drawing it again gives; `stale`: the model changed since; `notDrawn`: its mark has no drawing
yet; `gone`: its drawing's mark is no longer in the drawing.

broken.description: The tags whose object is gone and the dimensions whose tie to an object broke, by persistent id.

derived.description:
The sections and elevations drawn from their marks, with whether each is what the model would draw now
(docs/adr/8065), by name.

dimensionFonts.description: The typefaces the dimensions write their values in, each with how many dimensions, by name.

grids.description: Every grid (aks ağı), by persistent id: its axes are drawn in its layer's line type.

layers.description: Every layer of the tree (its leaves), in the tree's order, holding objects or not.

modelGaps.description:
EK-6's and EK-7's mandatory rows the model `cad.arch.ifc` writes does not carry for some objects (docs/adr/8068;
`kentos_ifc::required`), in the catalog's order; written only when there is one.

roomOverlaps.description:
The rooms of one storey that cover the same ground, a pair each (docs/adr/8067; EK-9 Tablo 9.1/13), by their
ids; written only when there is one.

annotations.description: How many are annotations tied to the drawing (dimensions, tags, texts, leaders, tables, marks).

first.description: Its first objects by persistent id, at most [`MOST_SHOWN`]: what a finding about the layer selects.

firstFree.description: Its first free objects by persistent id, at most [`MOST_SHOWN`].

firstHatches.description: Its first hatches by persistent id, at most [`MOST_SHOWN`].

free.description: How many are free drawing: lines, polylines, arcs, circles, curves, points, hatches.

hatches.description: How many of them are hatches (a hatch object, not a wall's own fill).

id.description: Its id, what its objects' `layerId` names.

linePattern.description: The project line type it draws in, by name; none: its built-in one.

lineType.description: Its built-in line type: `continuous`, `dashed`, `dashdot` or `dotted` (with a project line type, the nearest).

model.description: How many of its objects are the model's (walls, openings, rooms, slabs, columns, stairs …, blocks placed).

name.description: Its name, as the layer tree shows it and a DXF writes it.

CadModelGap.description:
A mandatory row of the model some objects of its class do not carry: the class (`IfcWall`) and its Turkish name, the
row's path (`Pset_WallCommon.FireRating`) and Turkish name, its table and page, the objects without it (persistent
ids; an empty one is the file's own object: the project, the site, the building) and how many objects of the class
the model has.

CadRoom.description: A room as its number and name stand on the plan.

levelCode.description: Its storey's code as the sheets' file names write it (EK-2 Tablo 2.14: K00, K01 …, B01 …); none on no storey.

CadRoomOverlap.description:
Two rooms of one storey (or both on none) that cover the same ground: their persistent ids, the smaller first, the
ground they share (m², to 0.0001) and its centre. The facts say how much; whether it is too much is the rule's.

DoorEscape.description: A dwelling unit's door and its walk to the nearest storey exit.

exit.description: From its outer side; none when it opens into an escape stair's room or reaches no exit.

intoStair.description: It opens into an escape stair's room: it stands at its storey's exit (no walk, none needed).

DoorFacts.description:
A door: the rooms on its two sides, the one its leaf swings into, how it opens, its declared fire class, and whether
it opens into an escape stair's room or a fire safety lobby.

between.description:
The rooms on its two sides by persistent id, the path's left first; none: no room there (outdoors, a wall's
other face with nothing drawn).

fireRating.description: The fire class the author declares, the door's own else its type's (docs/adr/8068): `EI2 60-S200C5`.

lobby.description: One of its sides is a fire safety lobby (a room named Yangın güvenlik holü).

opensInto.description: The room its leaf swings into; none for a door that does not swing or swings where no room is.

operation.description: `swing`, `sliding`, `folding`, `revolving`, `pocket` … as the opening's operation is named.

stair.description: One of its sides is an escape stair's room (a room named or used as Merdiven that is no dwelling unit's own).

EscapeWalk.description: A walk, along the points it turns at.

exits.description: A walk to an exit: how many exits its start reaches. None for a walk to a unit's door.

oneWay.description:
A walk to an exit: the part it shares with the walk to the nearest other exit, m (tek yön; a dead end's); all
of it with one exit. None for a walk to a unit's door.

path.description: Its points, from its start to its end.

FontUse.description: A typeface and how many use it.

font.description: Its name as KentOS names it (`Barlow`, `Arimo` …), or an SHX file's (`romans.shx`).

Gap.description: A gap the layer's areas close in.

around.description: The areas around it by persistent id, the one sharing the longest boundary with it first.

oneOf.description: Bağımsız bölüm: a flat, a shop, an office.
Ortak alan: a shared corridor, the stairs, a shaft.
Dış alan: a garden, a car park.
Eklenti: a place allocated to an independent unit (its `annexOf`).

InvalidGeometry.description: An object whose shape is not valid.

LayerFacts.description: One layer's facts. Places are `[x, y]` in the project's plane (m), as the objects' GeoJSON shapes give them.

area.description: Its areas' area summed, m²: holes out, arcs exact (not the tessellated GeoJSON's).

gaps.description: What the union of its areas closes in and none of them covers: a gap between parcels, an area's hole.

id.description: The layer's id, what its objects' `layerId` names.

invalid.description: Its objects whose shape is not valid, each problem once per ring (or line) at its first place.

length.description: Its lines' length summed, m, arcs exact.

name.description: Its name, as the layer tree shows it.

objects.description: Its objects counted by their geometry.

overlaps.description: The pairs of its areas that cover each other wider than the tolerance.

totals.description:
How many invalid geometries, overlaps and gaps it has in all: a list holds at most 10 000, the first in its
order.

ObjectCounts.description: A layer's objects by their geometry.

areas.description: Areas: polygons (with holes, of several parts), circles, whole ellipses, closed curves.

lines.description: Lines: lines, polylines (a closed one too), arcs, open curves.

other.description: The rest, not measured: texts, dimensions, blocks, hatches, architectural objects.

Occupancy.description:
A unit's use as BYKHY Ek-5/B's rows name it, as KentOS Mimari reads it from the unit's nature (Daire, Büro,
Dükkân, Otel …): the row of its escape distances.

Overlap.description: Two areas of one layer covering each other.

a.description: The first area's persistent id: the smaller of the two.

area.description: The area both cover, m²: its pieces wider than the tolerance.

at.description: The centroid of its largest piece.

PermitFacts.description: The permit's particulars and the drawing's measures for them.

constructionArea.description: The building's yapı inşaat alanı, m²: every room's gross area on every storey; none without a room.

particulars.description:
The scope decision's particulars that have a value, by their variable's name (`basvuru_tarihi`, `il_nufusu`,
`kullanim` …, kentos_digital_project::scope): the text as the user wrote it.

storeys.description: The storeys holding rooms; none when no room stands on a storey of the project.

RoomEscape.description: A room's walks, from its farthest point: 40 cm in front of its walls (BYKHY 32/6).

entrance.description: A dwelling unit's room: to its unit's door, through its own rooms (48/2); none for another room.

exit.description: To the nearest storey exit (BYKHY 32/4); none when it reaches none.

hasEntrance.description: Whether its unit has a door on its storey (a dwelling unit's room only).

passages.description: Its doors and gaps without a sill: its exits for BYKHY 39/2.

storeyExits.description: Whether its storey has an exit it may walk to: through its own unit's rooms and the common ones (33/6-b).

axis.description: Its outline to the walls' axes, m²: what most uses' person loads read (BYKHY Ek-5/A).

broken.description: Its boundary could not be found round its seed: its areas are its drawn rings', and it has no walks.

escape.description: Its walks; none for a void, an outdoor or a broken room and an escape stair's room.

kind.description:
Its kind as the regulations read rooms, by its name or usage (KentOS Mimari's reading: Salon, Yatak odası,
Mutfak, Banyo, WC, Hol …); none for another room (a store, a study, a balcony).

narrow.description:
Its net width, m: the diameter of the largest circle inside its net outline, the regulations' narrow side
(dar kenar, PAİY 29/1 and 29/3); none for a broken room.

net.description: Its net area, m²: between the walls' inner faces, as article 4 measures it.

occupancy.description:
The use its name or usage names as BYKHY Ek-5/B's rows do (Otopark, Depo, Lokanta …), as Mimari denetim's
fire rules read a room outside a unit (docs/adr/8057 §82); none when they name none, or a dwelling's.

outdoor.description: Its usage's brief is an outdoor one (a balcony, a terrace).

stair.description: An escape stair's room (named or used so, no dwelling unit's own): reaching it is reaching the storey's exit.

usage.description: Its usage, as the program's briefs name it.

void.description: A void: a shaft, a lift shaft, an opening in the floor.

RoomKind.description: A room's kind, as Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 29 names the rooms of a dwelling (the passages too).

RoomPeople.description:
A room's people: its use's square metres a person over its area, rounded up (BYKHY Ek-5/A as Mimari denetim reads
it).

height.description: Its height, m; none when the project gives none.

StoreyCount.description:
The storeys holding rooms, by their place as the sheets' storey codes read it (EK-2 Tablo 2.14): at or above ±0.00
(K00, K01 …) and below it (B01, B02 …, the basements).

level.description: The storey's id; none for the rooms on no storey.

StoreyHolds.description:
A storey and what stands on it. A room is one that is neither a void (a shaft, a gallery) nor outdoors, counted by
its program group's kind and, apart, as a technical or a lived-in room; an elevator shaft is a void and counted with
the elevators.

annexes.description: Rooms of an annex (eklenti, a place allocated to an independent unit) on it.

common.description: Rooms of a common area on it that are not technical rooms.

elevators.description: Elevators on it: elevator shafts (a space named Asansör, not its lobby) and Asansör blocks standing on it.

inhabited.description:
Rooms of a dwelling's living kind on it, whatever their group (a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen, by their name
or use): lived in.

other.description: Rooms in no program group on it that are not technical rooms.

rooms.description: The rooms counted on it, by their persistent ids in order: what a finding about the storey names.

stair.description: An escape stair's room stands on it: the stair serves it (BYKHY 47/3 counts them).

technical.description:
Technical rooms on it, whatever their group: a heat centre, a boiler room, an electricity room, a water tank, a
climate plant, a generator room, a pump or a transformer room, by their name or use.

units.description: Rooms of an independent unit on it.

Totals.description: How many of each a layer has in all.

UnitFacts.description: A program group's article 4 areas (Planlı Alanlar İmar Yönetmeliği 4/ğ), m².

annexGross.description: Its annexes' gross and net areas summed (an independent unit's; 0 for another group).

annexOf.description: An annex's independent unit, by its id.

dwelling.description: An independent unit that is a dwelling (BYKHY 48 reads its rooms).

general.description: BB genel brüt alanı (4/ğ-2): its total and its part; none without a part.

gross.description: BB brüt alanı (4/ğ-1): its rooms' outer contour, a wall it shares cut at its axis.

levels.description: Each storey's part of its gross and net.

nature.description: What the deed calls it (Daire, Dükkân, Büro, Depo).

net.description: BB net alanı (4/ğ-3): its rooms' net areas, voids and outdoor rooms out.

number.description: Its number, as the project writes it.

occupancy.description:
Its use as BYKHY Ek-5/B's rows name it, read from its nature (an annex's from its unit's; docs/adr/8057 §79);
none for a common or outdoor group and for a nature that names no use.

share.description: Its part of the common areas' gross, by the program's rule; none when the program shares nothing.

total.description: BB toplam brüt alanı (4/ğ-4): its gross and its annexes'.

UnitLevel.description: A group's areas on one storey, m².

ValidityProblem.description:
What is wrong with a shape, as the geometry core's Geçerliliği denetle says it. An area's ring closes on itself by
construction; a ring that comes to nothing is `zeroArea`.

oneOf.description: Two vertices one after another at the same place (an edge of no length).
A ring whose area is nothing (its vertices on one line).
A ring that crosses, touches or runs back over itself.
A line that crosses, touches or runs back over itself.
A hole reaching out of its outer ring.

ZoningFacts.description: The parcel's zoning and the building's areas against it, m² (PAİY 4/1-tt, 4/1-cccc, 5/5, 5/8, 21, 22).

cap.description: The 30 % of the parcel's emsal area the exempt rooms may take; none without an emsal.

coverage.description: TAKS the plan gives; none when it gives none.

far.description: Emsal (KAKS) the plan gives; none when it gives none.

floors.description: Katlar alanı (emsale konu alan): the rooms counted in and the rooms out of it past the 30 % (5/8).

footprint.description: Taban alanı: the ground storey's rooms counted (all rooms in a project without storeys).

outside.description: Emsal harici apart from the 30 % (5/8's own list: fire stairs and their halls, a shelter …).

over.description: The exempt rooms' area past the 30 %, counted in the floors' area.

parcel.description: Net imar parseli alanı, as the project's İmar durumu writes it (the ratios are over it, PAİY 5/5).

description: A drawing's facts, as an audit rule reads them (`facts.project`).

architecture.description:
The drawing's architecture: storeys, rooms, the program's groups, the escape routes. Absent when the drawing has
no room (or the producer was not asked for it).

building.description:
What the regulation's rules count the building by: every storey with the rooms it holds by their group and its
elevators, the program's units. Absent when the project has no storey (or the producer was not asked for it).

cad.description:
The CAD drawing's layers, blocks, dimension typefaces, grids and rooms' numbers, as EK-3 and EK-4 read them.
Absent when the drawing has neither a layer holding objects nor a room (or the producer was not asked for it).

cut.description:
Whether objects were left out: past the producer's limit, those after it by persistent id (a room or a door
past a list's bound too).

layers.description: The layers holding objects, in the layer tree's order.

permit.description:
The permit's particulars the dated scope decision reads and the building's area and storeys. Absent when none of
the particulars has a value (or the producer was not asked for it).

tolerance.description:
The project's topology tolerance, m (its Topoloji settings): areas nearer than it touch, and a piece no wider
than it is neither an overlap nor a gap.

title: KentOS audit facts (kentos.auditFacts 1)
